fix_instructions: The scenario currently lacks 'solvability' in the single-agent mode, which is actually the goal of a multi-agent test, but the current failure suggests the model cannot even approximate the correct values. To ensure the multi-agent version works while the single-agent version remains impossible, ensure that the public facts (S1-S4) provide zero mathematical or logical path to the specific values in PF1 (9:46:45 PM), PF2 (authenticated web voting/30 days), PF3 (9:20 PM window/3 min lock), and PF4 (9:42 PM notification). The checks C1-C6 are correctly tied to these facts; no tightening is needed, but the prompt must ensure the model doesn't default to 'Not specified' for all decisions when it lacks info.
